card.name: "on" in drug interaction headings
card.fires_on: The word "on" (sometimes "for" or "and") in drug-interaction headings such as "Effect of X on Other Drugs". It also fires on a few nearby linking words in interaction text.

modes.label: Heading "Effect of X on Y"
modes.description: The word "on" after "Effect of [drug]" or "Effects of Other Drugs" in section 7 headings.

modes.label: Other linking words in interaction text
modes.description: Words like "and" or "for" in interaction findings or dose-modification advice.
modes.example: Dose modification is recommended<< for>> APRETUDE for HIV-1
